voices.name: Babushka Valya - Grandma Storyteller
voices.description:
A real Russian grandmother: soft, unhurried and genuinely kind, with natural folk intonations and a smile you can hear. Not acted, recorded from real life storytelling.

Best for: bedtime stories and fairy tales, folk tale audiobooks, memoir narration, grandma characters in animation and games, warm family food ads.

Key qualities: elderly, warm, caring, authentic, folksy.
